_doc: build_maps.py config. Paths: acr_multi = ACR install (sources), acb_retail = untouched ACB multi (converter input), acb_installed = the game's multi folder (skins forges are patched from its *.pre_dyers originals, falling back to the live files). Per map: index fixes every id the map gets (lines 9000000+100*index+2*variant+1/+2, CXB objIDs 0xd7e50010+0x10*index+2*variant/+1), so never reuse or reorder indices. slot = unused GameBootstrap LoadInfo World (bootstrap_worlds.json) whose name+id the map takes over; the game then loads multi/DataPC_<slot>.forge. variants = menu entries (CXB UnlockableMap + MpWorld): name_line = ACR line id (all languages are taken from ACR's DataPC_localization.forge), description = English text or null (ACR has none for these maps), tod = TimeOfDay, preview/loading = [forge, ACR TextureMapSpec entry, crop top (upright, 512px source -> 2:1 band)], forge 'extra' = ACR DataPC_extra.forge, 'map' = the map's own ACR forge.
